name: Portability Validation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # 2:00 AM UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'qumun/**'
      - 'main.go'
      - 'Makefile'

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build & test on ${{ matrix.kernel }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        kernel: ['6.12.2', '6.13', '6.14', '6.15', '6.16', '6.17']
    env:
      KERNEL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.kernel }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Clean previous build
        run: make clean || true

      - name: Build Gthulhu
        run: make

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: make test

      - name: Verify binary
        run: |
          if [ -f ./gthulhu ]; then
            ./gthulhu --version
          else
            echo "Binary not found!"
            exit 1
          fi
